rounds.text: Conceded: [E30], [E31], and [E32]. Despite theoretical margins of safety, the underlying business quality shows severe structural fractures, most notably a collapsed operating margin down to 24% in Mar 2026 from 50% three years prior, representing a devastating 26 percentage point compression [E16]. This margin erosion occurs alongside an inconsistent yearly and quarterly operating margin trend [E17, E18]. Furthermore, smart money is aggressively exiting the stock; foreign institutional ownership has fallen to 0.00% from 2.19% [E27], domestic institutions have dropped from 10.41% to 5.82% [E28], resulting in a clear negative institutional money flow signal [E29]. This institutional flight has battered market confidence, leaving the share price languishing at a mere 9% of its 52-week range and generating a brutal 40% loss over the past year [E5, E12]. Adding to the vulnerability, high client concentration leaves 35% of total revenue dependent on just the top 3 clients [E55].
